risk_summary: The disclosure identifies material exposure to currency volatility, inflation, supply-chain disruption, labor shortages, COVID-19-related demand declines, and estimation uncertainty. It provides some quantitative information and specific accounting-policy detail, but relies on broad forward-looking qualifiers and extensive business-description language. Overall risk tone is balanced but modestly confident, supported by stated mitigation actions and continued customer demand.
